name: Syntactic Sugar
source:
With his life seemingly on-track on the path that is ‘employment’, Tsuyoshi Nagamura begins his career as a web developer fresh out of university...

However, while the ins-and-outs of his job have almost all been decided, the situation he now finds himself in is almost one of dreams... all of his co-workers are girls?!

Syntactic Sugar explores the lives of ‘Team Garnet’ and their daily interactions at Hasou Web Solutions as they become closer together as co-workers, friends, and young adults playing the game of a soon-to-be workplace romance.”

‘Syntactic Sugar’ will be a fresh take on the traditional romantic English visual novel. The game will include a rich and emotional story coupled with joyful comedic scenes and lovable characters, painting a rose-tinted picture of workplace romances.

[From [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/19CEHfi7Vk7rNoOc6ub3a7oSzO1pjN2cX/view]Casting Call[/url]]
translation:
刚刚大学毕业的Tsuyoshi Nagamura，踏上了名为“就业”的道路，开始担任网页开发者。人生似乎终于步入正轨……

然而，虽然工作上的种种事务几乎都已确定，他眼下的处境，却如同梦境一般……自己的同事，竟然全都是女孩子？！

《Syntactic Sugar》围绕Hasou Web Solutions公司的“石榴石小组”展开，描绘成员们的生活与日常互动。作为同事、朋友，以及即将展开职场恋爱的年轻人，他们在相处中逐渐拉近距离。

《Syntactic Sugar》将为传统的英语恋爱视觉小说带来新意。饱含情感的丰富故事，配合轻快的喜剧桥段与讨人喜欢的角色，将描绘一幅浪漫美好的职场恋爱图景。
